label: Things prior in being do not depend on what is posterior to them as the posterior depend on them…
paraphrase: Things prior in being do not depend on what is posterior to them as the posterior depend on them; hence whatever is prior can in some way be without what is posterior to it, and not conversely (Aquinas, In V Metaph. lect. 13 n. 18, reducing every mode of priority to priority by being-without). It concerns pairs already ordered as prior and posterior; it says nothing of pairs not so ordered, and 'depend' is not given the counterfactual sense of DEF-DEPENDS-FOR-BEING.
